Name: Naaman, Son of Ehud
Summary: Son of Ehud who removed the inhabitants of Geba and begat Uzza and Ahihud.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:7: Son of Ehud who removed the inhabitants of Geba and begat Uzza and Ahihud.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Naaman stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
